subject: Tangotech executive workshop — onsite logistics & calendar confirms
messages:
From: Nora Patel <nora@tangotech.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.khan@tangotech.com>, Tangotech Facilities <facilities@tangotech.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 12:08:00 +0100
Subject: Exec workshop availability — November onsite at Tangotech HQ

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the great demo last week. Our exec team is keen to run a half-day workshop on Nov 9 or Nov 16 (Monday) at Tangotech HQ in London. The audience would be: CTO (Nora Patel), Head of Product (Samir Khan), and two product directors — total ~6 people.

Primary objectives: align on deployment options, review Dedicated capacity sizing, and run a short live run of a sample inference pipeline. We need recommendations for room AV (projector + dedicated laptop), preferred sequence for sessions, and Redwood headcount to send (presales + engineering).

Can your team confirm:
- Which date you prefer (Nov 9 or Nov 16)?
- Who from Redwood will attend (names/roles)?
- Any travel or reimbursement constraints we should be aware of?

We also may do a short virtual prep session the week prior (30–45 minutes) to align the agenda. Please loop in relevant folks.

Best,
Nora

Nora Patel
CTO, Tangotech
nora@tangotech.com
+44 20 7946 1020

Attachment: tangotech_site_map_v2.pdf (application/pdf) [stub]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Nora Patel <nora@tangotech.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 14:32:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Exec workshop availability — November onsite at Tangotech HQ

Hi Nora — thanks, excited to make this productive.

We can do either date but Nov 16 (Mon) works slightly better since it gives engineering time after the US holiday. Proposed Redwood attendees:
- Rishi Malhotra — Account Executive (lead)
- Laura Bennett — Solutions Architect (demo & AV lead)
- Monica Patel — Customer Success (adoption + rollouts)
- Optional: Vivek Kulkarni — Senior ML Engineer (deep-dive, remote or travel pending)

Logistics/questions:
- Tentative timing: 09:30–13:00 GMT for the main session, followed by a working lunch with execs (we can extend to 15:00 for a small hands-on lab).
- AV: projector, HDMI, one spare laptop for the live run. Laura can send a short AV checklist — cc'ing her.
- Travel: Redwood's standard travel policy allows economy flights + 1-night hotel for local UK trips; if Tangotech prefers to cover travel, let us know and we can share the reimbursement form.
- Prep: suggest a 40-minute prep call the week before (Nov 9–13 window).

I'll hold Nov 16 on my calendar for now and will ask the team to block that date. If you confirm Nov 9 instead, we'll flip the holds.

Thanks — next steps: confirm date and preferred session end-time, and we will circulate an agenda + logistics pack.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0103

Attachment: redwood_travel_reimbursement_form.pdf (application/pdf) [stub]

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec workshop availability — logistics checklist + who travels

Rishi / Monica — quick internal note before we confirm:  

- Laura (Solutions Architect) will definitely travel. I'll bring the dongles and a backup MacBook with local model weights cached.
- Monica, can you lead the adoption slide (20m) and be ready to run the hands-on with 2 Tangotech engineers?
- Vivek: I recommend he join remotely for the exec portion and plan to travel only if Tangotech wants the lab extended past 14:30. Remote deep-dive is fine for initial ops questions.

AV checklist I've asked Facilities for (copy below). If Tangotech can't provide a wired HDMI, we should bring a wireless clicker and adapter. I'll attach AV spec sheet to the final pack.

Proposed final agenda (short):
- 09:30 Welcome & Objectives (Rishi) — 10m
- 09:40 Product & Hosting Options (Laura) — 30m
- 10:15 Dedicated sizing & economics (Monica) — 25m
- 10:45 Break — 10m
- 10:55 Live run (Laura + Vivek remote) — 45m
- 11:40 Q&A & next steps (All) — 20m
- 12:00 Working lunch / optional hands-on lab 12:30–14:30

I'll prep the AV spreadsheet and the room spec (attached).

Thanks — Laura

Laura Bennett
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com

Attachment: room_av_spec_sheet.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet) [stub]

From: Nora Patel <nora@tangotech.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.khan@tangotech.com>, Tangotech Facilities <facilities@tangotech.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 16:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Exec workshop availability — onsite logistics & calendar confirms

Hi Rishi / Laura / Monica — thanks for the quick turnaround. Nov 16 works for us. Please go ahead and book travel for Laura and Monica. We will cover Vivek's travel if we decide to extend the lab — otherwise remote is fine.

Confirmed timing: 09:30–13:00 GMT with optional lab until 15:00. Please send final agenda and a short logistics packet (parking, building access, Wi‑Fi) — facilities will coordinate badges on receipt of names.

I've attached a signed NDAs checklist; please complete the visitor form and return. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Nora

--
Nora Patel
CTO, Tangotech
